messages.subject: Change default scale for scale_fill_...
parts:
Hello

By default, it seems ggplot2 uses scale_colour_hue() (see book, page 106). I would like however to change this default, so that it uses my own scale scale_fill_manual(value = 1:7). How can I do it globally? Locally I can always add:
qplot(color, data = diamonds, fill=color,geom = "bar")+scale_fill_manual(value = 1:7)

but I would like the change to be global... i.e., by default qplot uses my scale, instead of scale_fill_hue(). I had a look at theme_update() and update_geom_defaults() but these do not concern the scale_fill... Is it possible to do it globally, or do I have to do it locally each time?

Thanks!

Matthieu

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Change default scale for scale_fill_...
parts:
In the next version, you should be able to do:

scale_fill_discrete <- function(...) scale_fill_manual(..., value = 1:7)

Here's the note from the NEWS file:

* `set_default_scale` has been removed. If you want to change the default
scale for an aesthetic, just create a function called
`scale_aesthetic_continuous` or `scale_aesthetic_discrete` that returns the
scale that you want. For example:

p <- qplot(mpg, wt, data = mtcars, colour = factor(cyl))
p
scale_colour_discrete <- scale_colour_brewer
p

Hadley
